reference_tokenizer: private HY4 tokenizer used on source host only; no tokenizer/model assets included
format: UTF-8 JSONL gzip; text field re-tokenized with the target model

basic.operation: redact complete decoded source first, then take deterministic contiguous token-window excerpts; no padding or concatenation
basic.interpretation: 512 distinct excerpts from 40 recorded source requests; NOT 512 independent production requests

long_context.operation: decode prefix_ids + tail_ids for each full source request, remove model control tokens and redact
long_context.interpretation: full rendered prompt text, not original messages/tools API bodies

limits: Subsamples are correlated and cannot estimate production-wide traffic distributions.
Basic excerpts are not an answer-quality or MTP acceptance evaluation dataset.
No original arrival timing, image payloads, tools API replay, or target-model exact length guarantee.
Reference token counts exclude the target model chat wrapper; client re-tokenization is required.
